commands.review_summary:
Adds Android Gateway-backed slash command discovery, New Chat controls, guarded session creation, native i18n updates, and focused Android tests.

PR surface: Other +803. Total +803 across 11 files.

Reproducibility: yes. by source inspection: ChatSheetContent passes Gateway commands into the public ChatComposer, where selecting `/new` only fills input and Send calls `viewModel.sendChat`. I did not run the Android app in this read-only review.

target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

No linked issue; this is a team-approved Android PR.

Android chat did not give users a discoverable way to start a fresh conversation or discover Gateway-backed slash commands from the composer. Earlier PR iterations also exposed session-command behavior that could diverge from the safer Control UI invariants: `/new` could travel through normal message send instead of Android's guarded New Chat path, and New Chat could still be available while active or queued chat work made a session switch unsafe.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds Android New Chat controls backed by Gateway `sessions.create`, a Gateway-backed slash command picker that opens when users type `/`, prefix filtering by command name or text alias, and guarded handling for Android session creation. New Chat is disabled while sending, streaming, loading, running, or queued chat work is active; delayed `sessions.create` responses are ignored if the selected session or run state changed; selected or typed `/new` routes through the guarded Android New Chat path; and admin-gated slash commands Android cannot safely execute are filtered or disabled instead of requiring Android to request `operator.admin`.

Scope boundaries: Android does not request or persist `operator.admin`, this PR does not add a permanent slash button in the composer, and admin-gated reset execution is not part of the PR claim.

## User Impact

Android users can start a fresh chat from the header `+` action or with `/new` when chat state is safe. Typing `/` shows Gateway-backed command suggestions that narrow by command name or alias prefix, so Android no longer depends on a hard-coded fallback command catalog. The composer no longer shows a persistent slash character between the attachment icon and message placeholder. New Chat is unavailable when it would risk abandoning active or queued chat work, and stale created-session responses no longer overwrite a newer selected session.

## Evidence

Latest PR head covered by this body: `708b6094d5126cff9df2f5a70e9a80feb899aebc`.

Focused source/build proof run on the patched branch:

```bash
git diff --check
pnpm native:i18n:check
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug --console=plain --stacktrace
```

Results:

```text
git diff --check: pass
pnpm native:i18n:check: pass, entries=2363 changed=false
Focused Android unit proof: BUILD SUCCESSFUL for ChatControllerCommandControlsTest and ChatCommandControlsTest
Android playDebug assemble proof: BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

Focused Android coverage locks the relevant behavior:

- Gateway command metadata parsing and slash prefix filtering.
- Unique `New chat`, `New chat 2`, `New chat 3`, etc. labels.
- Parent-linked `sessions.create` includes the selected parent session and `emitCommandHooks=true`.
- New Chat is disabled while active or queued chat work exists.
- Stale `sessions.create` responses do not switch away after selected session or run state changes.
- Selected or typed `/new` routes through the guarded Android New Chat path.
- Admin-gated slash commands are filtered or disabled instead of requiring Android `operator.admin`.

Visible Android emulator proof links:

Header `+` creates a unique new chat session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

`/new` starts a new session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

Admin-gated slash-command interaction captured during review of the permission-aware filtering path:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb

Slash command filtering:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3

Not tested in this phase: full Android release build matrix, physical-device pairing, and a live visual recording of the active-run race guard. The active-run and stale-response guards are covered by focused Android regression tests rather than video.
